body.x: CabinR participated in ‘2018 CES SHOWSTOPPERS’ held in Las Vegas on 9th(U.S. time standard) and introduced a bag with alarm system function.

CabinR has made two bags, a backpack and a messenger model. In this bag, there is an alarm system that works with RFID(Radio Frequency Identification tags to protect users from theft. This bag has an alarm device, activated by pressing a button, and it is easy to control because it can be deactivated by simply tapping RFID plastic card. When someone else opens the bag, the sensor detects the movement and makes a big, annoying sound that can only be turned off by a private CabinR card. It is expected to be popular with travelers.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
